journey.title: Enable anonymous public assets
journey.purpose: Allow anonymous system fetchers to retrieve /public/* assets while preserving authentication for the primary application.

steps.intent: Open the selected route's access boundary and understand the current policy.
Review the global /public/* policy and capability readiness when configuration is shared.
Understand that the token exists but lacks Access Apps and Policies Edit permission.
Review the exact /public policy changes before applying them.
Confirm that only /public/* is anonymous and the main application remains protected.

claims.statement: The journey makes it impossible to mistake /public/* asset bypass for anonymous access to the primary application.
